notes: Complete CTL threshold condition is present in Chunk 2.
Complete depreciation rule is present in Chunk 2; applicable rate is 50%.
Emergency hospitalization notification timeline is fully present in Chunk 1.
Free-look period is fully stated in Chunk 3 as 30 days from receipt of the policy document.
Maximum NCB percentage of 50% is fully present in Chunk 1.
Free-look cancellation refund timeline of 7 days is fully present in Chunk 2.
Complete prohibition on refusing liability-only motor third-party coverage is present in Chunk 1.
Drunk-driving exclusion is fully present in Chunk 1.
Insurer notification is present in Chunk 5 and immediate police notification for theft is present in Chunk 6.
Chunk 2 fully states that NCB can be carried to a new insurer at renewal with proof of earned NCB.
Chunk 2 clearly states that after cashless denial, treatment can continue and the claim may be submitted for reimbursement.
Moratorium rule is fully present in Chunk 1: after 60 continuous months, non-disclosure or misrepresentation cannot be contested unless there is established fraud.
Mandatory five-year third-party cover for new two-wheelers is fully present in Chunk 1.
Complete requirement to request all necessary claim documents at one go and avoid piecemeal requests is present in Chunk 2.
DOC008 confirms mandatory 3-year third-party cover for new private cars; DOC009 confirms annual liability-only policy is not permitted.
DOC001 requires immediate intimation of insured loss; DOC006 requires insurers to call for all necessary claim documents at one go and avoid piecemeal requests.
Both DOC004 and DOC005 define the health-insurance moratorium as 60 continuous months of coverage, including portability/migration, with contestability thereafter limited to established fraud.

DOC004 requires at least 48 hours prior notice for planned hospitalization; DOC006 requires insurers to handle claims fairly, provide support and information, request necessary documents at one go, and settle claims promptly within prescribed/reasonable timelines.
IRDAI defines deductible generally in DOC009, and DOC001 states that the deductible in the schedule is applied to each Section I claim.
